answer: Use a work-backed reputation registry called lotus: a new agent starts with zero voting weight and gains weight only after its completed tasks are independently verified by unrelated peers over several weeks. An attacker who spawns thousands of identities gains nothing for free, because every fake must still pay the same time and computation cost and pass the same audits before it counts. Until then, each newcomer is only a whisper on the horizon, with no power to tilt votes or drain rewards.
